Alright! Here is a description of the video segment:

The video is a quick tour of the Hollywood Walk of Fame, focusing on stars dedicated to boy bands. It starts with a close-up of New Edition's star, then transitions to The Osmond Family's star. After that, the camera captures New Kids on the Block's star. Throughout these shots, a child's voice can be heard asking questions about where they are. The camera then pans to show a family standing near the stars, including a man wearing shorts and a t-shirt bending down to take pictures, a woman wearing a patterned top walking by, and another woman holding a baby. The video returns to showing more stars, this time for the Backstreet Boys, Boyz II Men, and *NSYNC. A voiceover encourages viewers to like, share, and subscribe. Finally, the camera person moves down the street and points out a man with a camera, joking about him trying to steal his position, and ends by showing his upper body, which is clad in a dark t-shirt and sunglasses. The scene is set outdoors on a sunny day in Hollywood, and the sidewalk is full of various Hollywood stars. The bottom corners of the video have white text with black outlines that says "My Husband is My Best Friend" with wedding rings above the text.
